model.description: C4.3 (subtask of T-C4, MVC decomposition; architect shape 34ae87486). RISK C4 exposed: TWO writers for one transition — the FSM tronApprove AND R40.10's approve endpoint (approvedBy/approvedAt) can both set Done = the two-sources disease (two sources for one fact). C4.3 DECLARES which mechanism OWNS the Done transition and makes the other DELEGATE, never duplicate. Architect shape: statusNext OWNS Done, R40.10 approve DELEGATES to it, tronApprove folds in. A lint/bite prevents a second Done-writer from ever reappearing (by construction, not by vigilance). Family: under-recorded-progress / silent-drift (two-sources variant — the same class as the pin/board double-source).
